observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 187.» (L4, beside the head of chapter 51) and «p. 188.» (L24) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 51: 5 stands beside «CAPUT LI.», 10 in the space below the title, 15 beside L12.
body L4-L7: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type; «CAPUT LI.» is centred, the title is set as a paragraph of three lines, the second and the third indented.
body L2: «60ᵖ» is written with a small raised italic p (partes).
body L2: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «124,2, pro referta l. relata.»; the printed «referta» is kept.

body L1, L2: a speck stands over the g of «geo»; the o of «longinquitas» is printed broken; the m of «semidiametrum» is printed broken, like ni, and a speck stands over its r; the specks are not accents.
body L3: a slanting speck stands in the right margin beside the line; it is not a sign.
body L5: a thin slanting speck stands at the foot of the n of «in» before «sphaera»; it is not a comma.
body L8: a speck stands over the comma after «ortibus», at the top of the s; it is not the point of a semicolon.
body L11, L28: the first stem of the m of «semper» is printed broken, like a colon; the s of «nostri» is printed broken, like 3.
body L30, L32: the letters of the references (a) and (b) are bold italic; with chapter 51 the letters begin again at a.
notes_left L6, L7: a speck stands after the point of «Sept.»; it is not a second point. The hyphen of «Me-» is printed as a round point at the height of a hyphen.
notes_right L7: of the closing parenthesis of «(9)» only the foot printed, like a comma; the full stop after the fraction stands high, at the top of the 3.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
